messages.hud.canvas: Game map. Hold left mouse to move, right mouse to run. Click a monster to attack; Shift+left-click to attack without moving.
messages.hud.keys: Hold left mouse: move · Right mouse: run · Click enemy: attack · Shift+click: attack in place · F: pick up · 1–6: items · F1–F8: skills · B: bag · C: character · K: skills · M: map · Esc: menu
messages.hud.assistHint: Auto potions, sword skills and loot filter
messages.bag.organizeHint: Merge stacks and sort potions, scrolls, skill books, equipment and materials
messages.bag.lockedHint: Row {{row}} is locked. A Bag Expansion Ticket costs 20,000 Gold at the general store and unlocks 8 slots.
messages.bag.expansionHelp: Visit the Village Peddler (304,608) and choose Buy Supplies & Bag Tickets, or visit the Bichon City General Merchant. Each ticket costs 20,000 Gold and unlocks 8 slots, up to 4 times.
